summary: Shows the last run, size and failures of your Backrest or Kopia backups, and warns when one is overdue.
does: Backups watch puts cards on your dashboard for your backups. For each Backrest plan or Kopia source it shows the last run, the size and any failures, with a small chart of sizes.

It sends an alert through Starboard once when a backup is overdue or its last run failed, and once more when it is fine again. Its alerts are on by default. It only reads from Backrest or Kopia. It was written without trying it against the real programs, so read its Problems help before relying on it.
for: People who already run Backrest or Kopia for backups and want to notice a missed or failed backup without opening each tool.
needs: Backrest or Kopia already running, with its address and, if it asks, its user name and password. Alerts go to where Starboard sends its own, so set those up in Settings, Alerts to hear them. Needs plug-in API 1.17 or later.
shows: Three dashboard cards: Backups (a status), Backup runs (each plan or source) and Backup sizes. Settings are Backup tool (Backrest or Kopia), Its address, User name, Password, Accept a self-signed certificate, Overdue after (36 hours) and Send alerts through Starboard.
